newsitem.title: UK: PowerGen letter dents profit forecasts - FT.
newsitem.headline: PowerGen letter dents profit forecasts - FT.

text.p: British utility group PowerGen Plc has written a letter to analysts which has led to expectations that its profits will be substantially lower than some forecasts, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The newspaper said PowerGen's pre-tax profits for the year to March 31, 1997 were now expected to come in between 530 million stg ($866 million) and 585 million stg ($955.8 million).
Estimates for the group's profits had been as high as 660 million stg ($1.08 billion), the FT said.
The letter, which the company described as a "pre-closed season" list of pointers, highlighted a lower range of "key analysts' forecasts", according to the newspaper.
PowerGen quoted a range of 61-69.8p for earnings per share and 27.1p to 34.2p for dividend per share, the FT said.
